purpose: Descriptive release review only; no changes to projections, adoption guards or model selection
triage: P1: unexpected component failure or stale history with >=200 PA/60 IP. Expected zero-AB secondary batting rates are P2, not a broken ordinary hitter forecast. Remaining priorities follow registered descriptive rules.
sparse: Fewer than two positive MLB seasons or <200 MLB AB/<300 MLB outs in 2023–2026
stale: No positive 2026 MLB exposure; missing is not zero
rehab: Recorded rehab transactions and affiliate/year overlaps are evidence only; short annual MiLB stints are candidates, not proven rehab samples.
injury_roster: Existing dated/undated evidence only; no claim of current status or future opportunity
count_decomposition: Exact symmetric Shapley decomposition; hit components use PA x AB/PA x component/AB, other counts PA or decimal IP x count/exposure; this is an algebraic attribution, not causal talent inference.
history_attribution: Exact changes in weighted seasonal exposure contributions, including missing-versus-zero handling; season labels never used as 2026 forecast errors
minor_park_international: No new translation or playing-time substitution
